criteria.criterion: The use-tax return page has a "File now" panel with a button that opens Revenue Online in a new tab and, beside it, the DR 0252 lines in form order, each value with a Copy button, ending with a link to "I filed and paid it"; the app never submits or pays anything.
criteria.evidence: src/app/desk/sales-tax/use-tax/[periodId]/file-now-panel.tsx (wired into the page) has the Open Revenue Online button (new tab, noopener), the numbers in DR 0252 line order from src/domains/tax/use-tax-file-now.ts each with the existing Copy field, and a link to the 'I filed and paid it' return page. tests/w10-use-tax-file-now.test.ts checks the order, values and labels.

criteria.criterion: "Print the filled-in form" produces the current official DR 0252 PDF with the return's numbers filled in; until the official blank form file is supplied it is recorded as a scoped outside dependency and the page prints the line-by-line numbers instead.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/tax/dr0252-form.ts fills the owner-supplied official 2026 form (src/domains/tax/forms/DR0252_2026.pdf) through GET /desk/sales-tax/use-tax/[periodId]/form (owner and admin only); the form is picked by the period's year, a redesigned layout is refused, and System health asks for next year's form from December. Tests read the filled PDF back field by field; the output was also inspected as an image.

criteria.criterion: A runbook, docs/runbooks/colorado-filing-channels.md, records where each Colorado return is filed and paid, the DR 0252 line order and the official source URLs with the date they were checked.
criteria.evidence: docs/runbooks/colorado-filing-channels.md records where each Colorado return is filed and paid, the DR 0252 line order, the official source URLs and the dates they were checked (2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17).

criteria.criterion: The panel's numbers come only from the saved filing packet for that period (purchases, tax per area, total), are checked by a test against that packet, and are shown only to owner and admin.
criteria.evidence: The File now steps are built only from the saved filing packet (tests/w10-use-tax-file-now.test.ts compares them to a packet); the page and the form route both call requireRole OWNER/ADMIN; the panel contains no submit or pay control, only a link to the state's site and a link back to the owner's own recording form.

criteria.criterion: After a lead is converted, the lead page shows "Create quote" and "Start agreement" buttons that open the new quote or agreement for that customer.
criteria.evidence: src/app/desk/leads/[id]/lead-actions-panel.tsx shows Create quote and Start agreement (and Go to their customer page) after conversion, including after a refresh, using the lead's saved convertedCustomerId; both open existing pages (/desk/estimates/new and /desk/agreements/new with the customer).

criteria.criterion: Converting a quote to a rental opens the new draft agreement.
criteria.evidence: src/app/desk/estimates/[id]/convert-estimate-panel.tsx opens the single new draft agreement (or the agreements list when several were made) instead of only refreshing.

criteria.criterion: An agreement waiting for signature for more days than an owner setting (starting at 3, explained on the screen, with a restore button) puts "Follow up: <name> hasn't signed" on Today with a link to that agreement, and clears when it is signed or cancelled.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/agreements/unsigned-follow-up.ts and the owner screen /desk/settings/unsigned-follow-up (explanation, starting 3, restore button, audited, owner only, stale-save protection); src/domains/exceptions/unsigned-agreements.ts raises 'Follow up: <name> hasn't signed' linking to the agreement and clears when signed or cancelled. Proven in tests/w19-flow-gaps-integration.test.ts on real PostgreSQL.

criteria.criterion: A customer's repair request appears on Today at once as "Review <name>'s repair request".
criteria.evidence: UNREVIEWED_MAINTENANCE_REQUEST_DAYS is now 0 and the title is 'Review <name>'s repair request' (tests/w19-flow-rules.test.ts); the existing Today assembly query then lists a request as soon as it is submitted.

criteria.criterion: A customer can ask for a pickup in the portal; it arrives as a pickup request (not a repair) with a draft pickup visit, and the customer is told what happens next.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/portal/index.ts createPickupRequestForUser, called by the portal request form for the pickup kind, creates or reuses exactly one draft pickup visit with the customer's note and creates no repair request; it refuses another customer's appliance, and when it cannot tell which single rental is meant it falls back to an ordinary request for the owner to review (nothing is lost); the customer's open pickups are listed in 'Your pickup requests' in the portal. The customer sees 'we'll call you within one business day' (with Spanish). Proven in tests/w19-flow-gaps-integration.test.ts.

criteria.criterion: A rental that ended any way (term, early return, termination) gets a draft pickup visit and a Today item "Schedule <name>'s pickup" that opens it, plus a button on the agreement page.
criteria.evidence: closeAgreementInTx now creates the draft pickup visit when a rental ends with appliances still out; src/domains/agreements/pickup-needed.ts feeds a 'Schedule <name>'s pickup' Today item for ended or ending rentals with none, and the agreement page has a 'Schedule the pickup' button (owner/admin only, safe to repeat). Proven in tests/w19-flow-gaps-integration.test.ts.

criteria.criterion: Every step of the agreement progress card has a button that opens the page where that step is done.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/agreements/progress.ts returns a button for every unfinished step (signature, deposit, equipment, delivery, billing) and src/components/desk/agreement-progress.tsx renders them; every target is an existing /desk page. tests/w19-flow-rules.test.ts.

planComparison: Actual production change is about +610/-23 lines, inside the 700-line estimate. Both subsections, their boundaries and all frozen acceptance are unchanged and fully delivered; the filled-form step was possible because the owner supplied the 2026 official DR 0252 during the session. W-17 and W-20 were not started.
